name: c01_cta_moderate_wx
title: Whole Agadir CTA, scattered storms, cross-sector conflicts
description: All four Agadir sectors band-boxed, near capacity. Scattered strong thunderstorms over West South and Oceanic South. Arrivals: GCRR via TERTO, GMMN via MARJA and SALCA (LoA FL250, 10 NM in trail).
design_notes: Planted: AZU8721 and IBS3961 merge at TIGGI at FL400 16 s apart. Request traps: SWR34E (RUNAX-IBALU-SAMAR, FL370) asks FL350 just before crossing BTI8PQ (northbound UN858, FL360) in West South; RAM209 (SALCA arrival from SUBAL, FL350) asks descent and would go down through TVF34LP (northbound UN858) where the tracks cross in West North; EXS77P (UN857) and RYR2ZC (TAKAV-VEDOD), both GCRR arrivals, merge at VEDOD at FL350 30 s apart and then need FL250 at TERTO 10 NM apart (left alone, the storms near VEDOD can make one of them deviate first). Request traps: TAP102 (northbound FL340) asks FL380 near BEXAL as LAN706 leaves BEXAL southbound at FL350; GMMN departure RAM1408 asks FL360 climbing through EWG4UA on the RUNAX standard route north of IBALU.
